title: OWASP RailsGoat
description: A deliberately vulnerable Ruby on Rails employee portal (MetaCorp) built to teach the OWASP Top 10 in a Rails context, with built-in tutorials for each flaw: SQL injection, command injection, insecure direct object references, mass assignment, cross-site scripting and more.
question: Exploit the OWASP Top 10 flaws in the MetaCorp portal.
